meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 这个技能会把 cmem.ai 的 sync token、user id、SyncHub URL 写进插件配置(本机有 claude-mem 也会写一份),让记忆钩子能存取记忆;随后跑一次状态检查,只回报打码结果,不显示 token。
howto.when: 当你要求“设置 claude-mem”“连接 cmem”“Cowork 云同步”等,或提供 cmem.ai Connect 凭据时触发。

say.text: 在 Cowork 里设置云同步,把 claude-mem 和 cmem 连起来。
say.note: 会把凭据写入插件配置,并提示打包以便长期生效。

howto.what_en: Claude writes cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) into plugin config (and local claude-mem settings if present) so hooks can capture/inject memory, then runs a masked status check; the token is never shown in chat.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "connect cmem", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", etc., or provides cmem.ai Connect credentials.

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem for me; I'll paste the whole cmem.ai Connect blurb.
say_en.note: Extracts all three values into config; never echoes the token.

say_en.text: Connect cmem with my user id and SyncHub URL; token to follow.
say_en.note: Stores these values and asks for the missing token.

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync in Cowork and pair claude-mem with cmem.
say_en.note: Explains changes are session-only unless the plugin is repackaged.
